meta.label: Leo
meta.title: You were never just normal
meta.placeholderBody: Este espacio queda abierto para cuando quieras sumar tu nota.

paragraphs:
Maybe life felt ordinary back then,

but you never were.

There was always something extraordinary in the way you felt,

in the way you dreamed,

in the way you turned even pain into words.

You were never just normal to me.

You are more...
